verdict.rationale: Terminal payments live in the same Stripe system as online payments, and an official Stripe MCP server lets AI agents call the Stripe API, so an agent can plausibly reach Terminal transactions. Payouts exist as a documented concept, and webhooks plus an OpenAPI spec support programmatic access. However, nothing documents listing payouts or balance transactions via API, matching payouts to the charges they settle, or reconciliation reports. Missing for 10: documented API/agent retrieval of payouts and their component transactions, reconciliation or settlement reports for daily takings, ledger/accounting export or sync, and hands-on corroboration.
